summary_en: NEXON announced a special dividend of 415 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026, totaling approximately 324.0 billion yen. The dividend is funded from retained earnings and will be effective on November 25, 2026. An interim settlement was conducted as of June 30, 2026, to secure distributable reserves.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Settlement and Record Date Setting for Special Dividend (Surplus Dividend) and Special Dividend (Surplus Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
NEXON conducted an interim settlement as of June 30, 2026, and announced a special dividend of 415 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026. The total dividend amount is approximately 324.0 billion yen (provisional), funded from retained earnings, with an effective date of November 25, 2026. The interim settlement was established to secure the distributable reserves necessary for this dividend payment.

The company stated that it maintains a strong game portfolio centered on flagship franchises, generating stable high profitability with ample financial capacity. After securing sufficient investment funds for future business growth and maintaining adequate liquidity, the company determined that distributing accumulated excess capital directly to shareholders is the optimal approach to enhance capital efficiency. The company emphasized that this special dividend is a one-time measure to resolve accumulated excess funds and does not impair future growth investment capacity.

The company confirmed that future shareholder returns will be based on stable and continuous dividend payments and agile share buybacks. Should excess capital accumulate again in the future, the company will consider additional shareholder returns after comprehensively assessing the business environment at that time, while maintaining financial soundness and optimal balance with growth investments.
